findings: Fused planner/decomposer/next-action is the default until ablation justifies separation
Evidence and hypothesis graphs can share typed nodes while preserving claim status
Continuity/error/decision storage can share one durable substrate
Solver and falsifier need methodological separation, not just role names
Completed output and its receipt must commit together in one local boundary
Output hash must be verified before reusing cached work
Changed inputs must invalidate reuse by identity, not name
Remote unknown outcome cannot be solved by local retry alone
A successful deterministic continuity experiment does not select a complete cognitive architecture

rivals.mechanism: Specialists with independent verifier and falsifier
Existing QROS plus minimum deterministic inspectors
